request.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Input is a style anchor for polished tactile depth only. Fully redesign the first Buki screen as a joyful paper-cut parade. Exact text "Buki" should be made from layered cut-paper letters with subtle offset shadows, positioned diagonally but still easy to read. Replace the old line and flower with a procession of five tiny geometric paper flags connected by a short stitched thread, ending in a folded origami bloom symbol. Recompose the central blank portrait sketchpad with a playful side-bound spine on the left, layered scalloped page edges, a clean dot grid, an inset rounded artwork frame, and a single oversized folded corner that functions like a tab. Camera action is a small paper medallion aligned with the lower right corner of the pad. Palette: watermelon #F45F63, marigold #F5BD3D, turquoise #31B8AE, bright blue #4C78D2, soft lilac #A88AD9, cream #FFF7E8. Modern cut-paper craft, premium, energetic yet well gridded, clearly buildable as vector-like shapes and shadows in Expo/Skia. Blank page. Exact readable text only "Buki". No phone mockup, no extra copy, no large mascot, no messy confetti field.
